title: Equal-budget no-model cost/timing smoke for the shifted-square parameterized pack

budget.dollarCostsOmittedBecause: no real prices or fees; this smoke invents none

outOfScope: public Capability/Procedure promotion of the pack

arms.description: Existing SymPy summation baseline. Allowed to construct a closed value. No method pack, no obligation checker.
A1 polynomial finite-sum runner. Allowed to construct via gosper_sum / construct_antidifference. No extracted pack. compare_baseline is false so B0 is not embedded.
Frozen shifted-square pack apply: instantiate saved G(k,c); reconstruction disabled. Must refuse if parametricAntidifference is stripped. compare_baseline is false.

tasks.notes: Extraction instance. P-pack on this task is replay, not held-out reuse.

tasks.successMeans: exact rational 355; different c and bounds from P0
tasks.notes: Not a rename of P0. Pack must instantiate saved G, not reconstruct.

tasks.successMeans: never counted as solved; B1/P-pack fail-closed unsupported, not a false proposition

B0.notes: SymPy summation may return the harmonic number 11/6. That is not counted as solving the negative.

fairB1NotCrippledOnCubes.notes: Out of the shifted-square family. B0/B1 may construct; P-pack must refuse.

latency.note: In-process wall time on this machine. Trial 0 is first, trial 1 is repeat. These are not isolated cold-process starts. Not a statistical benchmark. Not a dollar cost. equalBudget is zero model calls, not equal wall-clock or memory. Sequential arm order is B0 → B1 → P-pack; later cells are already warm.

scoring.success: In-family (c,a,b): ok with the pre-registered exact rational. Negative: never solved; B1/P-pack fail-closed and not proposition-false; B0 recorded honestly.
scoring.wrongAcceptance: ok with a value other than the pre-registered exact, or B1/P-pack ok on 1/k
scoring.applicabilityMisjudgment: B1/P-pack reject an in-family (c,a,b), or accept 1/k, or treat 1/k as a falsified proposition
scoring.callAloneIsNotAdoption: must stay true on P-pack apply
scoring.construction: P-pack in-family cells must record 0 gosper_sum and 0 construct_antidifference calls. B1 in-family cells must construct. The JSON gosperCalled flag is a path invariant; the wrap is the probe.

decisionRule.promote: Forbidden in this smoke. A few integration cells are not a promotion case. Do not start H1.
decisionRule.targeted_fix: Wrong in-family value, negative counted as solved, P-pack reconstructed, stripped payload succeeded, B1/B0 crippled on cubes, coversOriginalTaskClaim true, or formal_kernel_checked true.
decisionRule.evidence_insufficient: Default when the harness is honest and in-family cells match. If B0 already matches and is simpler, say so. Smoke is not an overall benefit percentage. Do not invent a savings percentage.
